question: An article was sold at x% profit for Rs. 875. When the same article was sold for Rs. 896, the profit made was 3% more than the previous profit. The value of x is:
solution:
**Given:**

Article was sold at x% profit for Rs. 875

The profit made was 3% more than the previous profit if the same article was sold for Rs. 896

**Formula used:**

P% = (SP-CP)/(CP)×100

**Calculation:**

When article was sold at x% profit for Rs. 875

P% = (SP-CP)/(CP)×100

x = (875-CP)/(CP)×100 ......(1)

If profit percentage increases 3% then,

Profit % = (x + 3)%

(x + 3) = (896-CP)/(CP)×100 ......(2)

Put the value of x in equation (2) from equation (1) 

(875-CP)/(CP)×100 + 3 = (896-CP)/(CP)×100

⇒ (87500-100CP)/(CP) + 3 = (89600-100CP)/(CP)

⇒ (87500-100CP+3CP)/(CP) = (89600-100CP)/(CP)

⇒ 87500 - 97CP = 89600 - 100CP

⇒ 100CP - 97CP = 89600 - 87500

⇒ 3CP = 2100

⇒ CP = 2100/3 = 700

Now, From equation (1)

x = (875-CP)/(CP)×100 

⇒ x = (875-700)/(700)×100

⇒ x = (175)/(700)×100

⇒ x = 17500/700

⇒ x = 25

**∴ The value of x is 25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**(x + 3)% - x% = 896 - 875

⇒ 3% = 21

⇒ 1% = 7

⇒ 100% = 700

∴ CP = 700

Profit(%) = x% = (875-700)/(700)×100 = (17500)/(700) = 25

∴ The value of x is 25
